label: rem:frobenius-self-duality-forces-lp-dual-extraction-interpretation
title: Categorical content: self-duality of $\mathbf{Rep}(H_n)$ behind the LP dual
html: Remark (categorical content). The Frobenius self-duality holds at the categorical level: the rigid monoidal category \mathbf{Rep}(H_n(R,q)) is self-dual under the \tau-pairing, and \tau is precisely the categorical trace \mathrm{tr}_C on the unit object. The "primal vs. dual" distinction in the LP is a K-theoretic shadow of the categorical self-duality; there is no other choice.
